summary: Client-facing marketing landing scores 6.05 total — below the 8.0 client-facing bar. Stock dark-cyan-gradient palette + manifesto verbs + emoji-in-button + card-grid-of-three composition = AI-aesthetic template. Needs signature type, palette identity, and one hero interaction.

findings.message: Hero uses bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-cyan-900 — the exact stock dark-cyan-gradient template that reads as 'AI SaaS landing.' Tells 1 + 5 + 7 fire together with default type + card-grid + emoji icons. Under marketing-site archetype 'what earns 6.0' floor.
findings.suggestion: Kill the gradient hero — replace with a signature background (single-color with a distinctive type moment, or a hero device that couldn't be another SaaS's landing).

findings.message: 'Imagine your studio. Unleashed.' + 'Empower your creative workflow' + 'Boundless possibilities' — four manifesto verbs in the same view. Also caught by copy-lint regex. Content dimension caps at 4.0.
findings.suggestion: Replace with a specific proof: '700 studios cut export time 4x' or the actual outcome. Manifesto verbs are the tell of writing before deciding what to say.

findings.message: Zero signature interaction on the hero. Three-card feature grid with emoji icons IS the default AI SaaS composition. Under marketing-site archetype 'signature signals' section: 'A perfect marketing site can be recognized by ONE image or motion moment even without the logo.'
findings.suggestion: Invest one hero interaction — a scroll-driven type transformation, an interactive product moment, a signature device from the operator's own product (film-slate/timecode motif per DESIGN_EXCELLENCE §3).

top_changes.change: Replace manifesto verbs ('Imagine.', 'Unleash', 'Empower', 'Boundless') with a specific proof headline and a concrete CTA label. Kill the rocket-emoji-in-button.
Kill the stock dark-cyan-gradient hero + adopt a signature typographic pairing (not Space Grotesk + Inter). One distinctive display face on hero, a considered mono variant for any numeric proof.

Add one signature hero interaction that communicates the product's core value (a scroll-choreographed type moment, an interactive product device). Not decoration — one memorable moment executed with restraint.
